chapter: Youth, the road and arrival in California
title: Avoiding the draft by staying 1A all through the war
summary: Callender never mentioned his military school and was never called, while friends like Bumps Myers went into the Army.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Years later...I guess it's all right to tell it now... But when the War started, I never did tell them I went to ROTC school. See, I was officer material, but I never put that down. For whatever reason, I was in 1A the whole duration of the War and never got called. I was on a 21-day furlough and they never called me.

Yeah, I thought so, and I never asked why. Bumps and a lot of the other guys went, you know, and said, 'When are you going to call me?' -- and in two weeks they were in the Army. And I never asked why, and I never got called. And after the War was over, I got a new

classification -- 3A. So I have found out that I really hadn't done anything illegal. Either my card must have gotten stuck behind someone's, or someone up there just decided that I belonged in the Army. Because I really didn't feel as though I did belong in the Army. You know, I'm anything but violent, and I never would have shot anybody... After having been in military school, I knew what the Army was like. When somebody says "Jump" you had to jump. And I just didn't dig that kind of discipline.
Well, you're right. You are lucky. You were very lucky.
